title: bouch-engineering
summary: Specialist engineering evidence assessment for native coding agents. Consult when a result needs independent verification, evidence conflicts, a change must be attributed across agents or a dirty working tree, or a clean instrument result needs a known-positive control. Its added value over native agents is stated as unproven by its own marketplace docs.
